version_name: Review fixes: ISA load/save integrity + server-mode hardening

critical: ISA Standard Entry: Save on any exercise after a project load / autosave recovery / Excel import no longer replaces the loaded rows of that category with only the rows added this session; the Responses Save no longer drops the R arm (review N1, PR #60).
ISA Standard Entry: New Project / loading another project no longer inherits the previous project's elements, loop connections and case info (review N2, PR #60).
high: Recent Projects: folder/project observers are inert outside local mode and the open-folder shell call quotes its path (review N9/N10, PR #61).
Settings > SES Models: custom directories are refused outside local mode and the server filesystem is never offered as a browse root; models cache is keyed by directory (review N12/N13, PR #61).
Decision Lens narrative escapes element labels; feedback admin tables escape user text and the duplicate-marking endpoints require admin (review N15/N18/N19, PR #61).
Autosave-load containment requires a path separator after the root (review N56, PR #61).
